title: Course Objectives
items: Design, implement, test, and debug Python programs using fundamental programming constructs.
Analyze problems and develop appropriate algorithms to generate software solutions.
Utilize variables, expressions, data types, and assignment statements appropriately.
Implement sequence, selection, and repetition control structures.
Develop modular applications using functions and parameter passing.
Explain programming language paradigms and evolution.
Demonstrate understanding of scope, visibility, binding, and lifetime.
Design and implement object-oriented software using classes and inheritance.
Apply software engineering principles including documentation, readability, maintainability, and testing.
Create applications that utilize files, collections, and exception handling.
Develop complete software solutions that satisfy requirements.
Analyze programming problems and select appropriate algorithms, data structures, and implementation strategies.
